question.text: Mr. Vikram Joshi is the sponsor of 'Saraswati Growth Fund', a Cat II AIF with a target corpus of INR 400 crore. What is the MINIMUM continuing sponsor/manager 'skin-in-the-game' commitment he must maintain under Regulation 10(d)?

answer.text: INR 4 crore or 1% of corpus, whichever is lower
INR 5 crore or 2.5% of corpus, whichever is lower
INR 10 crore or 5% of corpus, whichever is lower
INR 20 crore or 10% of corpus, whichever is lower

explanation.text: The Logic: For Cat I and Cat II AIFs, the sponsor/manager must maintain continuing interest of not less than 2.5% of corpus or INR 5 crore, whichever is LOWER. On INR 400 crore corpus, 2.5% = INR 10 crore; INR 5 crore is the lower figure and applies. The Trap: The other options misstate the Cat I/II continuing-interest rule. Note: The workbook supports the lower-of 2.5%/INR 5 crore continuing-interest rule for Cat I/II AIFs. Cat III/PMS comparisons and any sponsor-drawdown commentary have been removed as they are broader than the checked source.
